title: dactylorhiza sphagnicola var. deweveri
intro: Dactylorhiza sphagnicola var. deweveri, commonly known as the marsh helleborine, is a type of orchid native to Europe and parts of Asia. The marsh helleborine is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and aid in digestion. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the cardiovascular system, improve circulation, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of the marsh helleborine include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
